requestedRefinements: Brighter original long curling seal pattern inside regular concentric circular boundaries
Warm orange/amber translucent seal background aligned to the draft
Denser translucent meteor shell with only a faint rock core
Continuous whole-surface decay without the former rear gap
animationMethod: Cocos registered continuous relief surface, textured rock mesh and animated flame textures.
nativeCaptureMethod: Actual formal FIR02 ultimate input in the isolated legal-level training range; normal test journey enters and returns at level1. Default camera4.3, complete HUD and visible actors. Each native video is270frames/30fps/9seconds. Closeup is crop only; no VFX/text overlays or retiming.
continuityReviewScope: Actual1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2.2/2.8/3.5s stages plus every frame in the1.2–2.4s transition. Pool counts and final clearing alone do not establish visual continuity.
visualLimits: Real camera projection is retained. User implementation-art feedback remains pending; no exact CG pixel match is claimed.
taptapDeviceValidation: Pending; browser capture is not device acceptance.

coolingContinuityEvidence.qualification: Review the actual native images and every transition. Active pool records, mesh counts and eventual clearing do not prove an unbroken visible fire surface.

sealColourThreeWay.processing: Crop and uniform resize only, with each original perspective preserved. No colour, brightness or effect changes.
